description: A complete, low-level Rust bridge to the MLX-C API of Apple's MLX array framework for Apple silicon, with owned handles, typed errors, and a safe path to every MLX capability, including gradients, vmap, FFT, Metal kernels, and safetensors.
rules: Call install_non_terminating_error_handler once at the start of the program, before any other MLX call.
Use MlxBindingsContext::on_cpu for linear algebra and float64, because the GPU does not support them.
Operations are lazy: call evaluate or a to_vec reader before measuring time or relying on a value being computed.
Read arrays through the to_vec and item families, which check the element type and return views in logical order, and convert with astype rather than reading as another type.
Create a context on each thread that uses MLX, because streams are thread affine and MlxArray is not Send.
